[{"signature":"sgp_lp_operacion.acceso_rol(text,text)","body_md5":"198c0afba93e748b8fd40e3eda5f8cfc","owner":"postgres","prosecdef":false,"proconfig":["search_path=\"\""],"proacl":"{postgres=X/postgres}","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sgp_lp_operacion.acceso_rol(u text, et text)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sgp_usuarios a WHERE a.usuario=u AND a.activo\n AND cardinality(sgp_lp_operacion.operaciones_rol(a.rol,et))>0\n AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sgp_rol_accesos r WHERE r.rol=a.rol AND r.permitido AND r.ventana IN('ensamble',CASE et WHEN 'ENSAMBLE' THEN 'ensamble.operacion-ensamble' ELSE 'ensamble.operacion-empaque' END))\n AND(a.rol='ADMINISTRADOR' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sgp_usuario_accesos v WHERE v.id_usuario=a.id_usuario AND v.permitido AND v.ventana IN('ensamble',CASE et WHEN 'ENSAMBLE' THEN 'ensamble.operacion-ensamble' ELSE 'ensamble.operacion-empaque' END))))\n$function$\n"},{"signature":"sgp_lp_operacion.contener_ambitos()","body_md5":"4bd286da759a7f14d9bb0b49dd9fff16","owner":"postgres","prosecdef":false,"proconfig":["search_path=\"\""],"proacl":"{postgres=X/postgres}","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sgp_lp_operacion.contener_ambitos()\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$ BEGIN\n IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AISLAMIENTO_AMBITOS_NO_ADMITIDO'; END IF;\n LOCK TABLE sgp_lp_operacion.perfil_roles,public.sgp_usuarios,public.sgp_sesiones_app,public.sgp_rol_accesos,public.sgp_usuario_accesos,sgp_lp_operacion.permisos IN SHARE MODE;\nEND $function$\n"},{"signature":"sgp_lp_operacion.operaciones_rol(text,text)","body_md5":"69274f528a2fed8001da535856649036","owner":"postgres","prosecdef":false,"proconfig":["search_path=\"\""],"proacl":"{postgres=X/postgres}","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sgp_lp_operacion.operaciones_rol(r text, et text)\n RETURNS text[]\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n SELECT CASE WHEN et NOT IN('ENSAMBLE','EMPAQUE') THEN ARRAY[]::text[]\n WHEN r='COORDINADOR' THEN ARRAY['LEER','ABRIR','SALE','EJECUTAR','NOTA','AFECTAR','VALIDAR','IMPORTAR_BI','IMPORTAR_XLSX','CERRAR','REABRIR','LIBERAR']\n WHEN r='ADMINISTRADOR' THEN ARRAY['LEER','ABRIR','SALE','EJECUTAR','NOTA','AFECTAR','IMPORTAR_BI','IMPORTAR_XLSX','CERRAR','REABRIR','LIBERAR']\n WHEN r='LIDER LINEA' OR(r='SUPERVISOR ENSAMBLE' AND et='ENSAMBLE') OR(r='SUPERVISOR EMPAQUE' AND et='EMPAQUE') THEN ARRAY['LEER','EJECUTAR','NOTA','AFECTAR','IMPORTAR_BI','IMPORTAR_XLSX','CERRAR']\n WHEN r='CONSULTA' THEN ARRAY['LEER'] ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END\n$function$\n"},{"signature":"sgp_lp_operacion.permisos_en_periodo(date,integer)","body_md5":"2bcf1551c9de003898e4bf663fe544b6","owner":"postgres","prosecdef":false,"proconfig":["search_path=\"\""],"proacl":"{postgres=X/postgres}","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sgp_lp_operacion.permisos_en_periodo(d date DEFAULT NULL::date, t integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)\n RETURNS SETOF sgp_lp_operacion.permisos\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\nDECLARE h jsonb; instante timestamptz; BEGIN\n IF d IS NOT NULL OR t IS NOT NULL THEN h:=sgp_lp_operacion.periodo(d,t); END IF;\n instante:=clock_timestamp(); -- después de toda espera de configuración horaria\n IF (SELECT habilitado FROM sgp_lp_operacion.perfil_roles WHERE id) THEN\n RETURN QUERY SELECT (jsonb_populate_record(NULL::sgp_lp_operacion.permisos,jsonb_build_object('usuario',a.usuario,'etapa',e,'key',x.key_produccion,'valid_from','-infinity','valid_until','infinity','duty','OPERATOR'))).* FROM public.sgp_usuarios a CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY['ENSAMBLE','EMPAQUE']) e CROSS JOIN public.sgp_producciones x WHERE x.id_linea='PANELES_2' AND sgp_lp_operacion.acceso_rol(a.usuario,e); RETURN; END IF;\n RETURN QUERY SELECT p.* FROM sgp_lp_operacion.permisos p\n WHERE p.revoked_at IS NULL AND sgp_lp_operacion.ambito_vigente(p.valid_from,p.valid_until,instante)\n AND (h IS NULL OR (p.valid_from<=(h->>'start')::timestamptz AND p.valid_until>=(h->>'end')::timestamptz));\nEND $function$\n"},{"signature":"sgp_lp_operacion.sesion(text,text,text,text)","body_md5":"f06e86fb101d602de053faa50d6696b3","owner":"postgres","prosecdef":true,"proconfig":["search_path=\"\""],"proacl":"{postgres=X/postgres}","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sgp_lp_operacion.sesion(token text, et text, k text DEFAULT NULL::text, line_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\nDECLARE s jsonb; BEGIN PERFORM sgp_lp_operacion.contener_ambitos(); s:=public.sgp_sesion_actual(token);\n IF s->>'valida' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' OR nullif(s->>'usuario','') IS NULL OR (coalesce(s->>'rol','') NOT IN('LIDER','LIDER LINEA','COORDINADOR','ADMINISTRADOR','CONSULTA') AND NOT((SELECT habilitado FROM sgp_lp_operacion.perfil_roles WHERE id) AND s->>'rol' IN('SUPERVISOR ENSAMBLE','SUPERVISOR EMPAQUE'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SESION_NO_AUTORIZADA'; END IF;\n IF et IS NULL OR et NOT IN('ENSAMBLE','EMPAQUE') OR line_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sgp_lp_operacion.permisos_en_periodo() p WHERE p.usuario=s->>'usuario' AND p.etapa=et AND(k IS NULL OR p.key=k) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sgp_producciones x WHERE x.key_produccion=p.key AND x.id_linea=line_id)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AMBITO_DENEGADO'; END IF;\n RETURN s; END $function$\n"},{"signature":"sgp_sesion_actual(text)","body_md5":"79efd30d18eac0950907b5248a2c79d5","owner":"postgres","prosecdef":true,"proconfig":["search_path=public"],"proacl":"{postgres=X/postgres,anon=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres}","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sgp_sesion_actual(p_token text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\ndeclare u sgp_usuarios%rowtype;\nbegin\n select x.* into u from sgp_sesiones_app s join sgp_usuarios x on x.id_usuario=s.id_usuario\n where s.token_hash=encode(extensions.digest(coalesce(p_token,''),'sha256'),'hex')\n and s.revocado_en is null and s.expira_en>now() and x.activo=true;\n if u.id_usuario is null then return jsonb_build_object('valida',false); end if;\n return jsonb_build_object('valida',true,'usuario',u.usuario,'nombre',u.nombre,'rol',u.rol);\nend $function$\n"}]
